title: Italian Blackberry Crumble
description: A sweet Italian dessert featuring fresh blackberries and a crunchy oat topping. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the blackberries and 1/4 cup sugar.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour, oats, baking powder, and salt.
Add the unsalted butter to the dry ingredients and mix until crumbly.
Transfer the blackberry mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Top the blackberries with the crumb mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, if desired.
